---
title: "Layla Module — Speech-to-Text Analysis"
subtitle: "Acoustic Pipeline for Arabic Phonological and Fluency Assessment"
---

## Overview

The **Layla Module** is the acoustic analysis engine of the platform. It uses **OpenAI Whisper** to transcribe children's Arabic speech in real time and performs **phonological error classification** — detecting specific patterns such as phoneme deletion, substitution, and fluency breakdown.

The module is designed around Palestinian/Levantine dialect phonology, targeting common errors in disorders like **phonological deletion** (e.g., dropping the initial /q/ in "قطار" → "طار") and **verbal stuttering**.

---

## Clinical Foundation

### Target: Phonological Deletion Detection

Phonological deletion is one of the most common error patterns in Arabic pediatric speech disorders. A child with this disorder may omit the initial consonant of a word. The module specifically models this:

| Child Says | Target Word | Error Type | Clinical Guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| طار | قطار | Initial phoneme deletion (/q/ omitted) | Practice velar stop /q/ from the pharynx |
| تتار | قطار | Consonant substitution | Distinguish /q/ vs /t/ articulation |
| قطار | قطار | ✅ Correct production | Positive reinforcement |

---

## System Architecture

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Child Speaks] --> B[Gradio Microphone\nInterface]
    B --> C[Whisper ASR\nArabic Transcription]
    C --> D[Text Normalization\nRemove Punctuation]
    D --> E{Phonological\nAnalysis}
    E -->|Exact Match| F[✅ 100% Correct]
    E -->|Deletion Pattern| G[❌ Phoneme Deleted\n+ Clinical Guidance]
    E -->|Other Error| H[❌ Mismatch\n+ Target Word Shown]
```

---

## Full Source Code

```{python}
#| code-fold: true
#| eval: false
#| filename: "speech_prototype.py"

import gradio as gr
import whisper
import torch

# 1. Detect GPU and load model on best available device
device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
print(f"Loading Whisper model on ({device})...")

# Base model — optimal balance between speed and Arabic phoneme accuracy
model = whisper.load_model("base", device=device)
print("Model loaded successfully!")

# 2. Define the target word for the current therapy session
TARGET_WORD = "قطار"  # Example: "Qitar" (Train)

def check_arabic_speech(audio_file_path):
    if not audio_file_path:
        return "⚠️ Please press the microphone and record your voice first!"

    try:
        # 3. Run Whisper with forced Arabic language decoding
        # language="ar" prevents transliteration to Latin script
        result = model.transcribe(audio_file_path, language="ar", task="transcribe")
        transcribed_text = result["text"].strip()

        # 4. Normalize: remove punctuation, keep alphanumeric + spaces
        clean_text = "".join(
            c for c in transcribed_text if c.isalnum() or c.isspace()
        ).strip()

        # 5. Phonological analysis and clinical feedback
        if clean_text == TARGET_WORD:
            return f"✅ Excellent! Correct pronunciation 100%!\nSpoken word: [{clean_text}]"

        # Detect initial phoneme deletion (child says طار instead of قطار)
        elif "طار" in clean_text or "تتار" in clean_text:
            return (
                f"❌ Phonological deletion detected (initial consonant dropped)!\n"
                f"Spoken: [{clean_text}]\n"
                f"Guidance: Try producing the /q/ sound forcefully from the back of the throat."
            )

        else:
            return (
                f"❌ Pronunciation does not match target.\n"
                f"Heard: [{clean_text}]\n"
                f"Target: [{TARGET_WORD}]"
            )

    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error processing audio signal: {str(e)}"


# 6. Build the Gradio interactive interface
with gr.Blocks(title="Smart Speech Therapy - AI Audio Unit") as demo:
    gr.Markdown("# 🎤 Real-Time Arabic Speech Analysis (AI)")
    gr.Markdown(f"### 🎯 Current Challenge: Pronounce the word **[{TARGET_WORD}]** clearly")

    with gr.Row():
        audio_input = gr.Audio(
            sources=["microphone"],
            type="filepath",
            label="Press the microphone and start speaking"
        )

    with gr.Row():
        check_btn = gr.Button("Analyze Speech 🚀", variant="primary")

    with gr.Row():
        output_result = gr.Textbox(
            label="Phonological Analysis Result",
            lines=4
        )

    check_btn.click(fn=check_arabic_speech, inputs=audio_input, outputs=output_result)

# 7. Launch with share=True for mobile microphone access
if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo.launch(share=True)
```

---

## Running the Module

```bash
conda activate speech_therapy
python speech_prototype.py
```

Once running, Gradio prints a local URL (and optionally a public share link):

```
Running on local URL:  http://127.0.0.1:7860
Running on public URL: https://xxxx.gradio.live
```

Open the URL on any device (phone or computer) and use the microphone.

---

## Whisper Model Sizes

The module uses the `base` model. You can upgrade for higher accuracy at the cost of speed:

| Model | Parameters | Arabic Accuracy | Speed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiny` | 39M | Low | Very Fast |
| `base` | 74M | Moderate | **Fast (default)** |
| `small` | 244M | Good | Medium |
| `medium` | 769M | High | Slow |
| `large-v3` | 1550M | Highest | Very Slow |
